Several hours (includes hunting 200 Dragons, opening 5 chests and killing 4 bosses)

Annual event (14 January to 12 February) about the First Dragon, son of Garsharak. {npc:Tamoril} tells you where the four descendants of the First Dragon live: you pass the trial of each (power, treasure, knowledge and life), kill {creature:Tazhadur}, {creature:Kalyassa}, {creature:Gelidrazah the Frozen} and {creature:Zorvorax} and use their trophies to open the First Dragon Lair. At the end you face {creature:The First Dragon} as a team and earn the {wiki:Festive Outfits|Festive Outfits} and several reward chests.
Section 7: when you use the four boss trophies on the square in front of the centre of the door.
The guide states **permanent** access; the quest is an annual event (14 January to 12 February).
